bin.description: How agents and hooks invoke wololo, e.g. "npx --no-install wololo".

harnesses.description: Agent harnesses to generate adapters for.

fast.description: Cheap enough to run on every agent stop.

command.description: Custom headless agent argv; "{prompt}" is replaced.

models.description: Model per harness for autopilot runs, e.g. {"claude": "opus", "omp": "local-gpu/nemotron-super"}. Unset: the harness's own default. Change it mid-run with m on the TUI's Autopilot tab; the next agent uses it.

protectedBranches.description: Branches autopilot never commits or merges onto (exact names or globs like release/*). A run started on one first switches to the plan's branch, or creates one named the repo's way (feature/…, fix/…). Default: main, master, develop, dev, development, stage, staging, release, release/*, release-*, releases/*, prod, production, trunk, hotfix/*, qa, uat.

hillClimb.description: Hill-climb rounds per step against .wololo/rubric.json after it passes the gate (default 1; 0 = off). Each round: a judge agent scores the judgment criteria, an improver agent works on the weakest criterion, and the change is kept only if the gate stays green and the score goes up. Stops at the first round without a gain. Costs two or three agent runs per round.

learn.description: Learned skills. After each step lands, wololo looks for workflows agents keep repeating. auto (default): one agent writes it down as a script or short skill, given only to agents whose step and role match; kept if those agents then need fewer turns, retired if not. suggest: only queue what it noticed. off: nothing.

workers.description: How many plan steps autopilot builds at once, each by its own agent in its own git worktree, merged back one at a time through the gate (default 1). Agents share one model server: on a local GPU more workers split its context and speed.

contextWindow.description: Agent context window in tokens. Sizes planned tasks and caps the output handed to agents.

stuckAfter.description: Stop when the same gate failure survives this many fix attempts (default 2).

agentTimeoutMinutes.description: Kill an agent run (and everything it spawned) after this many minutes, then let the gate decide what happens next (default 45; 0 = no limit).

stallMinutes.description: Kill an agent run early when it shows no progress (no output besides spinners and server retries, no file changes) for this many minutes (default 20; 0 = off).

gapRounds.description: After a plan lands, how many times a reviewer checks the goal against the repo and plans what is missing (default 3; 0 = off).

thinking.description: Reasoning level for headless agents that take one (omp --thinking). Default: low on a small contextWindow, else the agent's own default. Long thinking on a small local model fills the output cap and loops compacting.

tools.description: Only expose these commands as MCP tools (e.g. ["gate", "task note"]). Saves context on small windows.

sources.description: Outer-loop context sources. Each command prints a JSON array of items.
